wireframes_complete.description: Must be true — UI spec follows wireframes.

components_to_spec.description: Components from the wireframe component inventory that need full state specification.

component_name.description: PascalCase component name from wireframe inventory.

route.description: URL route this component belongs to.

fetches_async_data.description: True if this component fetches data from an API or Server Action. All 4 states required.

data_source.description: API endpoint or Server Action that provides data.

wireframe_ref.description: Reference to the wireframe showing this component.
